verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs confirm built-in CI/CD ("Get started with GitLab CI/CD — Build and test your application") and pipelines that run SAST, DAST and compliance checks, with findings shown in merge requests. A community user called the CI "truly great," and the Pulumi integration describes GitLab CI running on commits to specific branches. However, nothing in the pack shows pipelines defined as a config file in the repository, and push/merge-request triggering appears only indirectly through partner material and security-scan claims. missing for 10: first-party evidence of pipeline-as-code configuration stored in the repo, explicit documentation of automatic triggers on push and merge request events, hands-on corroboration of trigger behavior.
